# Bessel y

![Bessel y function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/bessel/07_Bessel%20y.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Spherical Bessel function of the second kind, signed integer order n; y_0(r)=-cos(r)/r. Distinct from cylindrical Y. At r=0: singular for n&gt;=0; 1 for n=-1; 0 for n&lt;=-2, using negative-order reflection. Formula: sqrt(pi/(2*r))*Y_(n+1/2)(r). Example: y_0(1)=-0.5403023058681398.
